review.notes: All 14 physical pages compared word-by-word against the OCR Markdown; no code fences exist in this source. Page 11 was rendered at 120 dpi to confirm the Contributors section structure. Remaining word-level differences are LaTeX math, soft-hyphen line breaks, and architecture-diagram labels printed inside figures. The PDF itself prints the typos 'an more advanced strategy' (p.1) and 'neibor views' (p.7) which OCR corrected; left unchanged per author-typo rule.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.11 shows 'Core Contributors:' printed as a bullet at the same list level as 'Project Sponsors:' and 'Project Leaders:' under the '6 Contributors' heading; OCR promoted it to a section heading, which duplicates the printed hierarchy (the real heading already exists as '## 6 Contributors'). The patch restores the escaped bullet form used by its sibling list items.

unresolved.evidence: Grid/legend labels from Figures 5-7 (Input, Model 1/2, Step1X-3D, 3DTopia-XL, Ours) are interleaved around the embedded figure images in OCR order; they are figure-internal text and match the rendered pages, so they were left unchanged.
